messages:
Jordan (CEO): Morning team — quick exec weekly. TL;DR: Private GA timeline firmed (May 14), SSO incident root cause found, and we signed off on a small policy shift for model fallback.

Lee (VP Ops): Thanks. Short bullets: 1) Private GA readiness checklist is live. 2) SLA/routing tweaks next week. 3) Incident follow-ups in this thread.

Maya (Head of Product): Docs draft posted: https://redwood-internal/docs/private-ga — please add privacy/legal blurb if you own it.

Ravi (Head of Eng): On the SSO incident: found a race in token refresh path that caused an elevated error rate during peak rotation. Patch rolling now, canary -> prod (ETA ~30m).

deploy-bot: deploy job #1245 started by @Ravi — rolling to gpu-serving-prod-canary — ETA 27m

Jordan (CEO): New policy note: default model fallback order is updated. Order is now: primary model -> quantized variant -> region fallback -> degraded tier. Rationale: reduces cross-region latencies and keeps output quality more consistent. See policy doc: https://redwood-internal/policies/model-fallback

Lee (VP Ops): We will update routing rules and add observability: p95/p99 latency per model+region. Target for tier-1: p95 < 120ms. Also adding alert if fallback rate > 2%/min.

Maya (Head of Product): Launch checklist items assigned in the doc. Marketing needs a 1-paragraph customer note and a 5-bullet FAQ for CS by May 1.

Ravi (Head of Eng): Postmortem outline posted in /incidents/SSO-2024-04: summary, timeline, root cause, mitigation, and an automated CI test for token rotation. Draft PR in 3 hours.

Jordan (CEO): Two asks: 1) a polished customer-facing note we can reuse across channels; 2) an internal CS FAQ. Lee/Maya please coordinate.

Lee (VP Ops): Taking both. I'll post comms drafts in #launch-collab and tag @cs-team for review.

Maya (Head of Product): Quick metric callouts to highlight in the launch note: Dedicated capacity adoption +15% MoM; cost per 1k tokens down 12% after batching/kv-cache optimizations.

Ravi (Head of Eng): Risk guardrail: if canary shows model quality regressions after quantized fallback, automated rollback to previous quantized model and notify eng-oncall.

Jordan (CEO): Appreciate the speed on the SSO fix — big kudos to SRE and Eng. :party_parrot: Small reminder: leadership offsite next week; keep the updates async and maintain the cadence.

Lee (VP Ops): Action items (summary):
- Lee: Update routing rules & alerts (by Thu)
- Maya: Finalize customer comms + CS FAQ (by May 1)
- Ravi: Finish patch + postmortem (by EOD)
- Jordan: Review + sign-off on fallback policy (by Fri)

Jordan (CEO): All good. If anything urgent, ping me directly. Otherwise, we'll reconvene next Friday for the scoreboard.

Maya (Head of Product): thanks

Ravi (Head of Eng): thanks

deploy-bot: deploy job #1245 finished: success
